# Synthetic EXIF fixtures

These JPEGs were generated locally with Pillow from an 80×60 solid color image.
They contain no user photos or location metadata.

- `capture-with-offset.jpg`: DateTimeOriginal `2020:01:02 10:30:00`, OffsetTimeOriginal `+08:00`.
- `capture-without-offset.jpg`: DateTimeOriginal `2020:01:01 10:30:00`, no offset.
